WITH days AS (SELECT calendar_date d, is_trading_day, day_of_week, holiday_name FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-10-04'),
st AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE store_id<900 AND store_id<>129),
sales AS (SELECT DISTINCT sale_date d, s.store_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE sale_date>='2026-05-04' AND channel_id=1)
SELECT st.store_id, count(*) cal_days, sum(CASE WHEN days.is_trading_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) trading_days, sum(CASE WHEN sales.d IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) days_with_sales,
 sum(CASE WHEN sales.d IS NULL AND days.is_trading_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) missing_trading, sum(CASE WHEN sales.d IS NOT NULL AND NOT days.is_trading_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sales_on_nontrading
FROM st CROSS JOIN days LEFT JOIN sales ON sales.d=days.d AND sales.store_id=st.store_id
GROUP BY 1 HAVING missing_trading>0 OR sales_on_nontrading>0 ORDER BY 1

WITH fy AS (
  SELECT min(period_start_date) AS start_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
),
sales AS (
  SELECT s.region, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date >= (SELECT start_date FROM fy) AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
    AND s.store_id < 900 AND f.channel_id = 1
  GROUP BY 1
),
rets AS (
  SELECT s.region, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE r.return_date >= (SELECT start_date FROM fy) AND r.return_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
    AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1
),
sales_p5 AS (
  SELECT s.region, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id < 900 AND f.channel_id = 1 GROUP BY 1
),
rets_p5 AS (
  SELECT s.region, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT sales.region, sales.sales_net, rets.refunds_net, sales.sales_net - rets.refunds_net AS net_sales,
  rank() OVER (ORDER BY sales.sales_net - rets.refunds_net DESC) AS rnk,
  sp.sales_net - rp.refunds_net AS net_sales_to_p5, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sp.sales_net - rp.refunds_net DESC) AS rnk_p5
FROM sales JOIN rets USING (region) JOIN sales_p5 sp USING (region) JOIN rets_p5 rp USING (region)
ORDER BY rnk

WITH s AS (
  SELECT cur.region, f.store_key, s0.store_id,
    CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-10-04' THEN 'TY' WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-09-28' THEN 'LY' END AS yr,
    f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s0 ON s0.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cur ON cur.store_id=s0.store_id AND cur.is_current
  WHERE f.channel_id=1 AND s0.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
),
r AS (
  SELECT cur.region, s0.store_id,
    CASE WHEN x.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-10-04' THEN 'TY' WHEN x.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-09-28' THEN 'LY' END AS yr, -x.refund_net AS net_amount
  FROM fact_return_line x JOIN dim_store s0 ON s0.store_key=x.store_key JOIN dim_store cur ON cur.store_id=s0.store_id AND cur.is_current
  WHERE s0.store_id<900 AND x.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
),
u AS (SELECT * EXCLUDE (store_key) FROM s UNION ALL SELECT * FROM r)
SELECT region,
 sum(CASE WHEN yr='TY' THEN net_amount END) ty_all, sum(CASE WHEN yr='LY' THEN net_amount END) ly_all,
 round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN yr='TY' THEN net_amount END)/sum(CASE WHEN yr='LY' THEN net_amount END)-1),2) growth_all_pct,
 round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN yr='TY' AND store_id NOT IN (125,119,129) THEN net_amount END)/sum(CASE WHEN yr='LY' AND store_id NOT IN (125,119,129) THEN net_amount END)-1),2) growth_lfl_pct
FROM u WHERE yr IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY growth_lfl_pct DESC

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.channel_id) ch, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key)
WHERE d.calendar_date >= '2025-04-28' AND s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH s AS (
  SELECT cur.region, s0.store_id,
    CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-10-04' THEN 'TY' WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-09-28' THEN 'LY' END AS yr,
    f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s0 ON s0.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cur ON cur.store_id=s0.store_id AND cur.is_current
  WHERE s0.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
),
r AS (
  SELECT cur.region, s0.store_id,
    CASE WHEN x.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-10-04' THEN 'TY' WHEN x.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-09-28' THEN 'LY' END AS yr, -x.refund_net AS net_amount
  FROM fact_return_line x JOIN dim_store s0 ON s0.store_key=x.store_key JOIN dim_store cur ON cur.store_id=s0.store_id AND cur.is_current
  WHERE s0.store_id<900 AND x.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
),
u AS (SELECT * FROM s UNION ALL SELECT * FROM r)
SELECT region,
 sum(CASE WHEN yr='TY' THEN net_amount END) ty_all, sum(CASE WHEN yr='LY' THEN net_amount END) ly_all,
 round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN yr='TY' THEN net_amount END)/sum(CASE WHEN yr='LY' THEN net_amount END)-1),2) growth_all_pct,
 round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN yr='TY' AND store_id NOT IN (125,119,129) THEN net_amount END)/sum(CASE WHEN yr='LY' AND store_id NOT IN (125,119,129) THEN net_amount END)-1),2) growth_lfl_pct
FROM u WHERE yr IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY growth_lfl_pct DESC

WITH ytd AS (
  SELECT DATE '2026-05-04' AS start_date, DATE '2026-10-04' AS end_date
),
sales AS (
  SELECT s.region, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  CROSS JOIN ytd
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN ytd.start_date AND ytd.end_date
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND f.channel_id = 1
  GROUP BY s.region
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT s.region, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  CROSS JOIN ytd
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN ytd.start_date AND ytd.end_date
    AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY s.region
)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY sales.sales_net - coalesce(refunds.refunds_net, 0) DESC) AS rank,
       sales.region,
       round(sales.sales_net - coalesce(refunds.refunds_net, 0), 2) AS net_sales_eur
FROM sales LEFT JOIN refunds USING (region)
ORDER BY rank
